subject: The Barrens colony at dusk, years on: the domes weathered and added to, a radio mast on the rise above them, fields of pale wiregrass going out to the flats, a few lamps shuttered. Long, quiet, the passing of time.
notes: Barrens, the bridge from Part 2 to Part 3. Screenprint light. Barrens' own dun and red ground, not the graveyard world. No faces.
